latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Photo Video — Turn Photos Into Shareable Videos.

- Upload photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP up to 200MB) and generate slideshow videos with music and transitions.
- Simple prompt-based workflow: describe your video and receive a 1080p MP4 in 30–90 seconds.
- Credits-based usage supported; session and token management are handled automatically.
- Download completed videos; view current timeline and manage drafts within a persistent session.
- Automatic error handling for file size, format, authentication, and export plan status.
- Ideal for users who want fast video creation from images without learning complex editing tools.
